arguments.sql: SELECT orders.id, orders.order_date, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS total FROM orders JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id WHERE customers.name = 'Seidel Gusstechnik AG' AND orders.id = 3 GROUP BY orders.id;
